versions.changelog:
- Major upgrade with enhanced coverage of the full banking and securities marketing cycle.
- Adds detailed customer segmentation logic using RFM, lifecycle, and risk preference factors.
- Introduces ready-to-use campaign design templates for both new client acquisition and reactivation.
- Enables AI-powered content generation for multiple formats (social, SMS, poster) with dynamic templates.
- Integrates an A/B testing analysis framework featuring conversion statistics, uplift calculation, and significance testing.
- Expanded trigger keywords and dual-language (English/Chinese) support for improved usability.
